corrections.proposed: 1914 lookout house approved and completed; 1933 replacement house built with CCC labor
corrections.why: Newspaper and Chronological History items on the Forest Lookouts page show a lookout house on the peak in 1914 and a new house in 1933. The NHLR records only the 1933 build.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR says the lookout was built in 1933 by the CCC. The Forest Lookouts items show a lookout house approved in 1914 and a new CCC-labor house in 1933. The story treats 1914 as the first house and 1933 as its replacement, and says the sources do not record what became of the 1914 building.
NHLR lists the Six Rivers National Forest as the location; a 1958 item places the lookout on the boundary between Six Rivers and Klamath. The story says it sits on that boundary.

notes_for_editor: The Forest Lookouts page quotes Chronological History of the Klamath National Forest volumes and Blue Lake Advocate and Siskiyou items; I did not check the original volumes. Source 3's title and publisher now match the PDF's own header (Forest Fire Lookout Association, California-Northern Chapter, 2025 Year-End Report). The 2025 report also has an Orleans entry marked 'Project Status: PENDING' that mentions tribal consultation; the project's scope was not confirmed, so the story does not use it. The 2013 item dates the wrap as 'August (7?), 2013', so the year is the only firm date. Access and rental status are not established; the brief lists access as unknown. A Forest Fire Lookout Association Facebook post in search results returned only its title, so it is not used. No photos added. Brief corrections: the built event needs the 1914 house and the 1933 replacement.
